title: Lamar's ankle and the 9-point line swing
subtitle: How one MRI flipped Sunday night at Atlanta, in five quick beats.
title_narration: Lamar's ankle, and the nine-point line swing.
as_of: Grounded in Jim's Interest Journal research for Tue Oct 6, 2026. Lines and injury status change fast; check before Sunday.

scenes.label: The MRI
scenes.heading: Left ankle sprain for *Lamar Jackson*

lines: Only an *"outside chance"* to play Sunday night at Atlanta.

scenes.caption: Lamar Jackson's MRI shows a left ankle sprain, and he has only an outside chance to play Sunday night at Atlanta. The injury isn't considered long-term and shouldn't need surgery.

scenes.label: The line at DraftKings
scenes.heading: From favorite to underdog
scenes.caption: At DraftKings, the line went from Ravens minus 6 on the lookahead, to minus 3.5 on Sunday night, to Baltimore plus 3. That's a 9-point swing.
evidence: At DraftKings it went from -6 (lookahead) to -3.5 (Sunday night) to Baltimore +3, a 9-point swing.
